table_states: Recorded entity states and attribute updates, including value, timestamp, previous state and operation context. This is the detailed History data source.
table_states_meta: Entity ID dictionary. states.metadata_id references this table so the long entity name is not repeated in every row.
table_state_attributes: Shared JSON attribute sets, such as unit, display name, device_class and device details. Several states can reference the same set.
table_events: Recorded events with timestamp, type, payload and context. In the current schema, state history is stored separately in states.
table_event_types: Event type dictionary, such as automation_triggered. events.event_type_id links an event to its type.
table_event_data: Shared event payloads in JSON. events.data_id references them; the hash helps reuse identical content.
table_statistics_meta: Statistical series metadata: statistic_id, source, unit and supported mean/sum. Its id is independent of states_meta.metadata_id.
table_statistics: Long-term hourly aggregates. Measurements store mean/min/max; counters store state and a corrected cumulative sum. Normal age-based purging retains these records.
table_statistics_short_term: Short-term five-minute aggregates. They feed hourly statistics and are cleaned according to the recorder retention period.
table_statistics_runs: Statistics processing log: periods for which aggregation ran. Does not contain entity values.
table_recorder_runs: Start, end and closure status of recorder runs. Useful for investigating restarts and unclean shutdowns.
table_schema_changes: Recorder database schema migration log. The schema version is not the Home Assistant release version.
table_migration_changes: Tracks specific data migrations and their versions to avoid unnecessarily repeating them.
table_sqlite_stat1: SQLite query planner estimates about indexes and distributions. An internal optimisation table, not household data.
field_metadata_id: Reference to metadata for this table family
field_state: Recorded value; period-end counter reading in statistics
field_last_updated_ts: Unix timestamp of the state or attribute update
field_last_changed_ts: Time the value changed; last_updated_ts when NULL
field_old_state_id: Previous state row; may already have been purged
field_hash: Hash used to find identical content
field_statistic_id: Statistical series name; linked to an entity by name
field_source: Statistics producer; recorder is not the device integration name
field_sum: Corrected cumulative total; not consumption for this hour
field_origin_idx: Origin code; not an integration identifier
field_event_type_id: Reference to the event type dictionary
field_data_id: Reference to the shared event JSON
field_time_fired_ts: Unix timestamp when the event occurred
